install.notes: The card lists no install command. The clone's environment is Python 3.8 (setup/conda_env.yaml:11). The clone is a script bundle: README.md:105-120 builds the build/ethercat_motor_py pybind extension with CMake and vcpkg (msgpack, eigen3, iir1); README.md:172-182 initializes motor_config.yaml; biped_controller.py:34-44 loads checkpoint/baseline. native.py imports the clone root at deployment only; the gate never imports or runs it.
